blocks.text: A rejected destination first checks the current role's scoped capabilities, then performs a narrow introspection search only when that view has no match. Both lookups fail closed to an unknown result.
blocks.title: Unknown-role observability

blocks.text: Visit counts are stored per session and role. Missing sessions do not create state, while recording increments the stored mapping and writes it back.
blocks.title: Visit bookkeeping

blocks.text: next_step handles ordinary plan progression, new known-role escalation, earlier-role rechecks, and hallucinated-role rejection. It enforces the revisit cap and returns both the target index and the reason.

purpose: This module returns the next index in an ordered role plan rather than resolving executable module names. It keeps routing deterministic while recording visit caps and optionally checking unknown destinations against scoped capabilities and source introspection.
side_effects: reads and writes visit counts and route traces
summary: Routes an EO role plan by role names, with escalation, revisits, hallucination rejection, and route tracing.
